ModMetaData.name: Fcitx CJK Input
ModMetaData.author: scarf
ModMetaData.description:
Fcitx5 CJK input support for RimWorld on Linux.
Uses fcitx5's IBus D-Bus compatibility layer to forward key events from IMGUI text fields to fcitx5, and insert committed text back.
기능: - Linux에서 fcitx5 한글/중국어/일본어 입력 지원 - IMGUI TextField/TextArea 지원 - D-Bus IBus 호환 인터페이스 사용
Requirements: - Linux RimWorld 1.6 - Harmony - fcitx5 with IBus frontend enabled
